instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.

frames.label: turn 1: Task rule: the charger is plugged in only when it stands on its own two prongs inside one of the power strip's outlets, body pointing up, pushed down far enough that its base disappears below the strip's top face, and both arms are back where they started - lying flat on the table beside the strip does not count. ORDER MATTERS HERE: aim first, push last. Standing it on its prongs, and turning the line through the two prongs parallel to the slots, both happen in clear air away from the strip; once the prongs hang over an outlet the hand only moves straight down, because a nudge sideways or a twist down there leaves the prongs standing on the strip's face. STEP 2 of 7: the strip is on the other arm's side of the table, so set the charger down in the middle first, get out of the way, and let the other hand take it from there. Right now the charger is still lying flat, prongs pointing sideways, the prong line is still turned across the slots, it is not over the strip yet, and the prongs are in and the body is sitting down on the strip. charger into the power strip (first set it down at the centre for the other arm): orient the right gripper and travel above the object
